name: Vigil Isaac
desc:
Vigil Isaac is an Etrean NPC. He is a newly appointed Vigil.

Isaac is brother to [Apprentice Kj](entity:apprentice_kj), having recently become a Vigil under [Evengarde Rest](entity:evengarde_rest). Giving him a Gale Stone allows the player to complete the quest "Vigi's Savior" and speak to Apprentice Kj to receive a Curiosity Talent hand and an audience with Evengarde Rest.
